description.value:
The inside of this satchel is darker than its leather can account for. It shifts on the shoulder like a sleeping animal, and it is always a little warm.

This satchel holds up to 5,000 pounds and never weighs more than 2 pounds. You can take out any item it holds as a Bonus Action, without searching for it.

The Satchel Eats. Once per day the owner can open the satchel toward a Large or smaller creature within 10 feet, which makes a [[/save ability=str dc=20 format=long]] or is swallowed. A swallowed creature is unharmed, needs no air or food, and cannot act; it comes out when the owner lets it out, when the satchel is turned inside out, or after 24 hours. The satchel holds one creature at a time. It grows restless when it has not been fed, and it has opinions about what goes into it.
